summary: Duos Technologies Group, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing an underwritten registered direct offering of 2,000,000 shares of common stock and 3,800,000 pre-funded warrants at $9.50 per unit, for total gross proceeds of approximately $55 million. The offering was conducted under an effective shelf registration statement on Form S-3. TD Cowen and Cantor acted as joint bookrunners. The pre-funded warrants have an exercise price of $0.001, are exercisable immediately, and include a 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation (which can be increased to 9.99% with 61 days' notice). This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
